correctness.rationale: Every palindrome meeting at most six alternating runs meets 1, 3 or 5 runs. Enumerating the distinct families with exact overlaps yields the displayed palindrome count; an elementary min/max identity gives both defect formulas for all positive run lengths. Removing endpoint letters characterizes all minimal nonrich five-run words, additivity excludes six-run minimals, and direct OGF summation counts the family. The seven-run explicit word is checked against its palindrome set. The standalone checker exhaustively tests 35,417 small profiles and 1,200 larger random profiles, but is not used as a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: This solves a natural unrestricted-parameter but bounded-structural-complexity part of the published minimal-nonrich-word problem. Exact positive defect, a local additive law and its sharp seven-run failure quantify more than simple richness testing; the entire five-run minimal forbidden family and length generating function give a reusable factor-language boundary classification. The result does not depend on arbitrarily selected finite examples.
